g.text: Each weight gets ∂L/∂W by the chain rule: the lane's signal times that layer's own slope.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #9aa3ad

g.text: the lane stops here: no gradient

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #9aa3ad

g.text: into the maps or the U-Net

g.text: Adam, learning rate 0.001: every trained weight moves

font-size: 9.75px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #20313c

g.text: Per update: 256 canvases (128 label 1, 128 label 0), one of the 16 timesteps and a fresh noise draw per canvas. 4,000 updates.

text.style: font-size: 9.75px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #20313c

g.text: The two branches run this same loop on the same network shape; only y and the canvas pool differ, so they end with different weights.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7a88

g.text: Source: v2_learn.py train(), lines 110-133. The weight counts are those of dc3; 'stem' is its three convs together.
